articles.title: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.09203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing benchmarks for autonomous AI scientists evaluate only final outputs---generated code, hypotheses, or papers---yet discard the reasoning process by which those outputs were obtained. articles.title: Gradland: On Phenomenal Experience, Differentiated Across Many Dimensions
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.09306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper investigates the hypothesis that the first-order structure of physical interactions, i.e. gradients or Jacobians, characterizes the structure of phenomenal experience. It does so in an idealized world inhabited by neural networks, Gradland, where the physics are known and the functions are (mostly) differentiable. articles.title: The Menu Is an Execution Prior: State-Path Tool Menus for Online Agents
